get.description:
The published problems. For a signed-in user they carry the statuses of the user, and the
answer is private; a guest's browser keeps the guest's statuses (FR-CAT-03), so the `status`
filter is UNAUTHENTICATED for a guest.

parameters.name: status

schema.description: Any of these statuses of the signed-in user (phase 2)
schema.title: Status

parameters.description: Any of these statuses of the signed-in user (phase 2)

get.description: The current version of a published problem and its acceptance rate.

A version up to the current one; its data never changes, so it is cached for a year (the
acceptance rate, which changes, is only in `GET /problems/{slug}`).

A picture of the statement of a version, `assets/<path>` of its package (FR-PRB-03). Like
the version, it never changes. A sandboxed CSP keeps an SVG opened by itself from running
scripts on the origin of the site.

post.description:
A Run or a Submit of the current version of a problem; the check runs in the background.
Sets the guest cookie with the first submission of a guest. RATE_LIMITED: `params.quota`
names the spent quota (docs/api.md). CAPTCHA_REQUIRED (guests only): solve
GET /captcha/challenge and repeat with `captcha`.

get.description:
Own submissions, newest first, and the quotas left: of the signed-in user, else of the
guest by cookie; empty without either.
A submission of the caller with its stages and artifacts.

The live log and progress of a check (specs/07 §4); after the stream expires, the same
events from the archive. The status is final only with the `finalized` event. While the check
waits, `queue` events carry its position; they have no `id:`.

200.description: Server-Sent Events: `data:` is a SubmissionEvent, `event:` its type, `id:` the stream entry id. `: keepalive` comments every 15 s.

post.description:
Cancel a queued or running check of the caller; the result comes as `finalized` with
`cancelled`.

get.description:
Download the latest file of an artifact of the caller's submission: `stage` names the
stage of a log or an FST, events have none. NOT_FOUND also when it has expired.

parameters.name: scope

schema.description: Which FST of the stage: the window or the whole test
schema.title: Scope

parameters.description: Which FST of the stage: the window or the whole test

302.description: Redirect to a presigned URL of the file (attachment)

post.description:
Record an FST with the seed of the submission (FR-WAV-05): the expired failure window
again, or the whole failed test of a Run (`full_test`), for guests and users alike. It is
pending until GET /submissions/{id} shows it ready or failed. A kept or pending FST is
answered as it is, without spending the quota. NOT_FOUND: no such submission, no trace
window in it, or `full_test` of a Submit; RATE_LIMITED: `params.quota` is `waveforms`.

get.description:
A new challenge for the next submission after CAPTCHA_REQUIRED; valid once, for the time
in `?expires=` of its salt.

Start a login with an OAuth provider: a page the browser navigates to, not a fetch, so
the rate limit is a redirect to the login page too. NOT_FOUND: the provider is disabled.

anyOf.description: Path of the site to return to after login

302.description: Redirect to the authorization page of the provider; to /login?error=rate_limited when the address starts logins too often

get.description:
Where the provider returns the browser. A failure is a redirect to the login page, not an
error document: the browser shows the page. The first login creates the account; the login
replaces the session of this browser.

302.description: Signed in: to `next` of the login. Failed: to /login?error=<reason>, reasons in docs/api.md

post.description:
Send a one-time login link valid for 15 minutes (FR-AUTH-05). The answer does not tell
whether an account exists. NOT_FOUND: email login is disabled; RATE_LIMITED: per email address
and per IP; CAPTCHA_REQUIRED: with the `captcha` flag.

202.description: A link is sent if the address can sign in; the same either way

post.description:
Sign in with the token of a link. The link opens a page of the site that posts the token,
so a link preview that fetches it does not spend it. The first login creates the account.
LOGIN_LINK_INVALID: unknown, used or expired; NOT_FOUND: email login is disabled.
End the session of the request; without one there is nothing to end.

204.description: The session is ended and its cookie cleared

post.description: End every session of the user, this one included (FR-AUTH-04).

204.description: Every session of the user is ended

get.description: The signed-in user; UNAUTHENTICATED for a guest.

delete.description:
Request deletion of the account in 7 days (FR-USR-05): `delete_at` is set, the profile is
hidden at once, sessions stay so that POST /me/restore can cancel it. Repeating keeps the
date. At `delete_at` the sessions end, and the account is deleted with its submissions,
drafts, logins and consents; its public solutions stay, as those of «удалённый участник»
with their places (ОВ-12).

patch.description:
Change the nick or the display name (FR-AUTH-02). NICK_CHANGE_TOO_SOON: `params.available_at`
is when it may change again.

post.description: Cancel a requested deletion; without one nothing changes.

get.description:
Own data with the code of every kept submission (FR-USR-05), as the file
`apparatica-<nick>.json`.
The saved draft of a problem; NOT_FOUND: none (FR-EDT-02).

put.description:
Save the draft of a published problem; the last save wins. NOT_FOUND: no such problem.
RATE_LIMITED: the autosave has its own window, apart from the other requests.

get.description: A public profile (FR-USR-04). NOT_FOUND also for a hidden account or one being deleted.

Public solutions of a user, newest first, with their places in the leaderboards pages
show now (FR-USR-04). NOT_FOUND as for the profile.

The leaderboard of a problem (FR-LB-01..04): one entry per author, the best accepted
Submit in the current epoch on the default toolchain profile. NOT_FOUND: no such published
problem or it has no leaderboard; VALIDATION_ERROR: `sort` names no column.

Public solutions of a problem, every version, several per author (FR-SOL-03); `rank`
orders them by the formula of the leaderboard, solutions without its metrics last. Code is
not listed: GET /solutions/{id}. VALIDATION_ERROR: `sort` names no column.

A public solution (FR-SOL-01, FR-SOL-02): metrics, author and place for everyone, the code
after the visitor's own accepted Submit of the problem (`code_locked`); the author sees
their own code. NOT_FOUND: no such submission, not public, or its problem is not published
(hidden solutions and authors arrive with moderation, T3.12).
Users by points for all time (FR-LB-05); `me` and `around_me` for a signed-in user.
